question: Unsa ang tumong sa Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) tali sa BFP ug City Hall sa pag-inspeksyon sa mga negosyo?
answer: The Joint Inspection Teams (JITs) are organized by the BFP and the City Hall for the inspection of businesses in relation to an application for a new business permit or renewal. This is stated in Section 9.1.2 of JMC No. 01 Series of 2021 [S1]. Additionally, LGUs are encouraged to use a system of risk classification of various businesses and adopt an inspection prioritization scheme, with the Department of Health for Sanitary Permits and the BFP for the Fire Safety Inspection Certificate, for the issuance of uniform guidelines on risk inspection for specific sectors. This is stated in Section 9.1.4 of JMC No. 01 Series of 2021 [S2].

ground_truth: Section 9.1.2 of JMC 2021-01 mandates the organization of Joint Inspection Teams (JIT) combining LGU inspectors and BFP personnel to conduct joint physical inspections, limiting face-to-face contact and eliminating redundant multiple visits.
